mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_member_user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_member_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amout), 0) FROM order_topup WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayRecharge, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amout), 0) FROM order_topup) AS totalRecharge, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_withdrawal WHERE DATE(application_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 0) AS todayWithdrawal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_withdrawal WHERE status = 0) AS totalWithdrawal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_info WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrders FROM dual
